subject: Physics
title: Thermal Properties of Matter
summary: Temperature batata hai heat kis taraf behegi; heat temperature difference ki wajah se transit mein energy hai. Celsius, Fahrenheit aur Kelvin scales linearly jude hain.
Zyadatar cheezein garam hone par failti hain: linear (α), area (β = 2α), volume (γ = 3α) expansion. Paani alag hai — 0 °C se 4 °C tak sikudta hai, isliye 4 °C par sabse dense.
Temperature badalne ki heat Q = mcΔT; constant temperature par state badalne ki Q = mL. Calorimetry bas 'heat lost = heat gained' hai.

Heat conduction (H = KAΔT/L), convection (fluid ki bulk motion) aur radiation (Stefan–Boltzmann, Wien's law) se behti hai. Newton's law of cooling: cooling ki rate ∝ surroundings se temperature difference.

formulas.name: Temperature scales
formulas.mistake: 1 °C change = 1 K = 1.8 °F — temperature DIFFERENCE mein 32 mat jodo.

formulas.name: Linear expansion
formulas.when: Rails, bridges, metal rods, pendulum clocks.

formulas.name: Area and volume expansion
formulas.formula: ΔA = A β ΔT,  ΔV = V γ ΔT;   β = 2α,  γ = 3α (isotropic solids)
formulas.when: Plate mein chhed, bartan mein liquid.
formulas.mistake: Plate ka chhed garam hone par BADHTA hai, ghatta nahi.

formulas.name: Thermal stress
formulas.formula: stress = Y α ΔT  (rod fixed at both ends)
formulas.when: Garam rod ke clamps par force.

formulas.name: Specific heat capacity
formulas.formula: Q = m c ΔT;  water c = 4200 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ = 1 cal g⁻¹ °C⁻¹

formulas.name: Heat capacity and molar heat capacity
formulas.formula: C = Q/ΔT = mc;  molar C = Q/(n ΔT)

formulas.name: Latent heat
formulas.formula: Q = m L;  ice L_f = 80 cal/g = 3.36 × 10⁵ J/kg;  steam L_v = 540 cal/g = 2.26 × 10⁶ J/kg
formulas.mistake: State change ke dauraan temperature constant rehta hai — wahan mcΔT mat lagao.

formulas.name: Principle of calorimetry
formulas.formula: Heat lost by hot bodies = heat gained by cold bodies
formulas.mistake: Ice ho to pehle check karo SAARI ice pighal sakti hai ya nahi, tabhi 0 °C se upar final temperature maano.

formulas.name: Conduction (Fourier's law)
formulas.formula: H = dQ/dt = K A (T₁ − T₂)/L;  thermal resistance R = L/(KA)
formulas.when: Rods aur deewaron se heat flow.

formulas.name: Slabs in series and parallel
formulas.formula: series: R = R₁ + R₂ (same H);  parallel: 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ (same ΔT)

formulas.name: Stefan–Boltzmann law
formulas.formula: P = e σ A T⁴;  σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴;  net loss = eσA(T⁴ − T₀⁴)
formulas.mistake: T kelvin mein hi lo, °C mein nahi.

formulas.name: Wien's displacement law
formulas.when: Garam bodies ka rang, stars ka temperature.

formulas.name: Newton's law of cooling
formulas.formula: dT/dt = −k(T − T₀);  average form (T₁ − T₂)/t = k[(T₁ + T₂)/2 − T₀]
formulas.when: Body ke thanda hone ka time.
formulas.mistake: Sirf chhote temperature difference ke liye valid.

examples.title: Rails ke beech gap
examples.problem: 10 m steel rails (α = 1.2 × 10⁻⁵ /°C), 50 °C rise ke liye gap?

examples.title: Garam aur thanda paani milaana
examples.problem: 80 °C ka 0.2 kg paani 20 °C ke 0.3 kg mein. Final temperature?

examples.title: Ice mein steam
examples.problem: 100 °C ki 20 g steam 0 °C ki 100 g ice mein. Final temperature? (L_v = 540, L_f = 80 cal/g)
examples.solution: Steam 0 °C tak heat degi: 20(540 + 100) = 12800 cal. Saari ice pighalne ko 8000 cal chahiye, toh saari ice pighlegi. Bachi 4800 cal 120 g ko garam karegi: T = 4800/120 = 40 °C.

examples.title: Copper rod se heat
examples.problem: Copper rod: K = 400 W/m K, area 1 cm², length 0.5 m, ends 100 °C aur 0 °C. Heat current?

examples.title: Do slabs ka junction
examples.problem: Barabar motai ke do slabs, K₁ = 2K₂, bahar ki faces 100 °C (slab 1) aur 0 °C. Junction temperature?

examples.title: Radiated power
examples.problem: Sphere ka radius double aur kelvin temperature aadha. Radiated power?

topics.title: Heat and temperature
topics.explain: Thermal contact mein bodies tab tak heat lete-dete hain jab tak temperature barabar na ho (thermal equilibrium). Heat joules mein (1 cal = 4.186 J). Absolute zero (0 K = −273.15 °C) sabse kam possible temperature.

topics.title: Anomalous expansion of water
topics.explain: Paani 0 °C se 4 °C garam karne par sikudta hai aur 4 °C se upar failta hai. Talaab upar se jamte hain: sabse dense paani (4 °C) neeche, ice upar tairti hai aur neeche ke paani ko insulate karti hai, isliye jal-jeevan bachta hai.

topics.title: Applications of expansion
topics.explain: Rails aur bridges mein gaps, garmi mein telephone wires dheeli, thermostats mein bimetallic strip (kam α wali metal ki taraf mudti hai), garmi mein pendulum clocks dheemi.

topics.title: Specific heat facts
topics.explain: Paani ki specific heat bahut zyada hai, isliye radiators aur hot-water bags mein use hota hai aur coastal climate narm rakhta hai. Gases mein Cp > Cv kyunki constant pressure par kuch heat work karti hai.

topics.title: Change of state
topics.explain: Jo cheezein pighalne par sikudti hain (ice) unka melting point pressure se ghatta hai — regelation. Boiling point pressure se badhta hai (pressure cooker) aur pahaadon par ghatta hai. Sublimation: solid → vapour seedha (dry ice, naphthalene).

topics.title: Convection
topics.explain: Fluid ki bulk movement kyunki garam, kam dense fluid upar uthta hai. Natural convection: sea aur land breeze, trade winds, room heaters. Forced convection: pankhe, blood circulation, car radiators.

topics.title: Radiation and black bodies
topics.explain: Radiation ko medium nahi chahiye, speed c. Perfect black body saari radiation absorb karti hai aur best emitter hai (Kirchhoff: achhe absorber achhe emitter). Garam bodies chhoti wavelength par peak karti hain (Wien) aur bahut zyada power deti hain (T⁴).

topics.title: Newton's law of cooling
topics.explain: Body surroundings se bahut garam ho to sabse tez thandi hoti hai; cooling curve exponential hai. Exam mein average-temperature form lagao jab tak log wala form na maanga ho.
